findings.description: In the sync wrapper, copy._local.statistics is set to self._local.statistics (the old dict) instead of the shared `stats` dict. The copy's retry loop therefore writes statistics into a different dict than the one exposed on wrapped_f.statistics.
findings.rationale: Trigger: any call to a function decorated with @retry. wrapped_f.statistics is cleared and assigned to self._local.statistics, but the copy writes to the old self._local.statistics dict. The user reads wrapped_f.statistics and sees an empty dict, so attempt_number and similar fields are lost. The async version correctly uses `stats`.
